command:
set -euo pipefail; echo '===IDENTITY==='; printf 'host='; hostname; printf 'user='; whoami; date -Is; echo '===VOICE_SERVICE==='; systemctl --user show frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service -p ActiveState -p SubState -p MainPID -p ActiveEnterTimestamp -p ExecStart -p Environment --no-pager; echo '===CLIENT_SERVICE==='; systemctl --user show frankenstein-chatgpt-client.service -p ActiveState -p SubState -p MainPID -p ActiveEnterTimestamp -p ExecStart -p Environment --no-pager || true; VEXEC=$(systemctl --user show frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service -p ExecStart --value 2>/dev/null || true); VPATH=$(python3 - "$VEXEC" <<'PY'
import re,sys
s=sys.argv[1]
m=re.findall(r"(/[^\s;{}\"']*voice_final_runtime\.py)",s)
print(m[0] if len(dict.fromkeys(m))==1 else '')
PY
); echo "VOICE_FINAL=$VPATH"; if [ -n "$VPATH" ] && [ -f "$VPATH" ]; then SDIR=$(dirname "$VPATH"); echo "SCRIPTS_DIR=$SDIR"; for f in voice_final_runtime.py voice_full_runtime.py omega_runtime.py frankenstein_identity_assembly.py omega_arm_bus.py omega_organ_activity.py voice_host_777_live_client.py frank_terminal_777.py; do p="$SDIR/$f"; if [ -f "$p" ]; then sha256sum "$p"; else echo "MISSING $p"; fi; done; echo '===OMEGA_CLI==='; if [ -x "$HOME/.local/bin/omega" ]; then "$HOME/.local/bin/omega" selftest; "$HOME/.local/bin/omega" status; else echo OMEGA_CLI_MISSING; fi; fi; echo '===PROCESS==='; VP=$(systemctl --user show frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service -p MainPID --value 2>/dev/null || echo 0); if [ "${VP:-0}" -gt 0 ] && [ -r "/proc/$VP/cmdline" ]; then printf 'cmdline='; tr '\0' ' ' < "/proc/$VP/cmdline"; echo; printf 'proc_start='; ps -o lstart= -p "$VP"; printf 'cwd='; readlink -f "/proc/$VP/cwd" || true; echo; fi
